questions.question: When I got to the station, the train ___ already left.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: When I got to the station, the train had already left.　過去のある時点（駅に着いた時）までに完了していたことは過去完了 had + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: When I got to the station, the train had already left.

questions.question: I lost the pen that my father ___ me the day before.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I lost the pen that my father had given me the day before.　なくした時より前にもらったので過去完了。
questions.tts_text: I lost the pen that my father had given me the day before.

questions.question: She said that she ___ tired.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: She said that she was tired.　時制の一致：said（過去）に合わせて that の中も過去形。
questions.tts_text: She said that she was tired.

questions.question: I'll wait here until you ___ back.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I'll wait here until you come back.　時を表す until の中では、未来のことも現在形。
questions.tts_text: I'll wait here until you come back.

questions.question: It ___ three years since he left Japan.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: It has been three years since he left Japan.　「～してから3年になる」は It has been ~ since …。
questions.tts_text: It has been three years since he left Japan.

questions.question: I don't know if he ___ tomorrow.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I don't know if he will come tomorrow.　「～かどうか」の if（名詞の働き）の中では、未来のことは will で表す。条件の if と区別する。
questions.tts_text: I don't know if he will come tomorrow.

questions.question: [I] [have visited] [Kyoto] [with my family] in 2020.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは I visited Kyoto with my family in 2020.　in 2020 は過去のはっきりした時なので、現在完了ではなく過去形。
questions.tts_text: I visited Kyoto with my family in 2020.

questions.question: I thought [that] [he] [will] [come] to the party.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは I thought that he would come to the party.　時制の一致：thought（過去）に合わせて will → would。
questions.tts_text: I thought that he would come to the party.

questions.question: He said [that] [he] [has lost] [his key] the day before.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは He said that he had lost his key the day before.　言った時より前のことなので過去完了。
questions.tts_text: He said that he had lost his key the day before.

questions.question: When we got there, the concert ___ (begin) already.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: When we got there, the concert had begun already.　着いた時までに始まっていたので過去完了。begin の過去分詞は begun。
questions.tts_text: When we got there, the concert had begun already.

questions.question: I knew that she ___ (live) in London then.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I knew that she lived in London then.　時制の一致で過去形（過去進行形）。
questions.tts_text: I knew that she lived in London then.

questions.question: 私が起きたとき、母はもう朝食を作り終えていました。

questions.answer: my mother had already made breakfast when I got up
accept: when I got up, my mother had already made breakfast
questions.explanation: My mother had already made breakfast when I got up.　起きた時までに完了していたので過去完了。
questions.tts_text: My mother had already made breakfast when I got up.

questions.question: 雨がやむまでここで待ちましょう。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: let's wait here until it stops raining
questions.explanation: Let's wait here until it stops raining.　時を表す until の中は現在形。
questions.tts_text: Let's wait here until it stops raining.

questions.question: He said, "I am busy."
questions.prompt_ja: 間接話法に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: He said, "I am busy." → He said that he was busy.　時制の一致で am → was。
questions.tts_text: He said that he was busy.

questions.question: Ten years have passed since he died.
questions.prompt_ja: He を主語に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Ten years have passed since he died. → He has been dead for ten years.　「死んでから10年」＝「10年間死んだ状態」。has been dead。
questions.tts_text: He has been dead for ten years.

questions.question: You ___ go out tonight. It's too cold.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: You had better not go out tonight. It's too cold.　had better の否定は had better not + 原形。
questions.tts_text: You had better not go out tonight. It's too cold.

questions.question: There ___ be a big tree here, but it was cut down.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: There used to be a big tree here, but it was cut down.　used to + 原形で「以前は～だった（今はちがう）」。
questions.tts_text: There used to be a big tree here, but it was cut down.

questions.question: When I was a child, I ___ often go fishing with my father.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: When I was a child, I would often go fishing with my father.　過去によくしたことは would + 原形でも表せる。
questions.tts_text: When I was a child, I would often go fishing with my father.

questions.question: You ___ come if you don't want to.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: You need not come if you don't want to.　「～する必要はない」は need not + 原形（＝ don't have to）。
questions.tts_text: You need not come if you don't want to.

questions.question: She looks very happy. She ___ have passed the test.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: She looks very happy. She must have passed the test.　must have + 過去分詞で「～したにちがいない」。
questions.tts_text: She looks very happy. She must have passed the test.

questions.question: I ___ rather stay home than go out today.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I would rather stay home than go out today.　would rather A than B で「B するよりむしろ A したい」。
questions.tts_text: I would rather stay home than go out today.

questions.question: [You] had better [to see] [a doctor] [soon].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは You had better see a doctor soon.　had better の後は原形。
questions.tts_text: You had better see a doctor soon.

questions.question: [I] used to [playing] [tennis] [every day] when I was young.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは I used to play tennis every day when I was young.　used to の後は原形。be used to ~ing（～に慣れている）と区別する。
questions.tts_text: I used to play tennis every day when I was young.

questions.question: [He] [can't] [have] [say] such a thing.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He can't have said such a thing.　can't have + 過去分詞で「～したはずがない」。
questions.tts_text: He can't have said such a thing.

questions.question: My grandfather used ___ (live) in this house.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: My grandfather used to live in this house.　used to + 原形。
questions.tts_text: My grandfather used to live in this house.

questions.question: You should ___ (study) harder last year.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: You should have studied harder last year.　should have + 過去分詞で「～すべきだったのに」。
questions.tts_text: You should have studied harder last year.

questions.question: そこへは一人で行かないほうがよい。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: you had better not go there alone
questions.explanation: You had better not go there alone.　had better not + 原形。
questions.tts_text: You had better not go there alone.

questions.question: 彼女はその知らせを聞いたにちがいない。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: she must have heard the news
questions.explanation: She must have heard the news.　must have + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: She must have heard the news.

questions.question: It is not necessary for you to hurry.
questions.prompt_ja: need を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: It is not necessary for you to hurry. → You need not hurry.　「急ぐ必要はない」。
questions.tts_text: You need not hurry.

questions.question: I'm sure that he was sick yesterday.
questions.prompt_ja: must を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: I'm sure that he was sick yesterday. → He must have been sick yesterday.　過去のことへの確信は must have + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: He must have been sick yesterday.

questions.question: This box is too heavy for me ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This box is too heavy for me to carry.　too ~ to …。文の主語（This box）が carry の目的語なので it はつけない。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: This box is too heavy for me to carry.

questions.question: He is old enough ___ to school alone.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: He is old enough to go to school alone.　形容詞 + enough to + 原形で「…するのに十分～」。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: He is old enough to go to school alone.

questions.question: Remember ___ this letter on your way.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Remember to mail this letter on your way.　remember to ~ は「（これから）忘れずに～する」。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: Remember to mail this letter on your way.

questions.question: I remember ___ him at the party last year.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I remember meeting him at the party last year.　remember ~ing は「（過去に）～したことを覚えている」。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: I remember meeting him at the party last year.

questions.question: Would you mind ___ the window?

questions.explanation: Would you mind opening the window?　mind の後は動名詞。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: Would you mind opening the window?

questions.question: I'm used to ___ up early.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I'm used to getting up early.　be used to ~ing で「～するのに慣れている」。この to は前置詞。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: I'm used to getting up early.

questions.question: [She] [is] [enough old] [to drive] a car.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは She is old enough to drive a car.　enough は形容詞の後ろに置く。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: She is old enough to drive a car.

questions.question: [I] [forgot] [bringing] [my umbrella], so I got wet.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは I forgot to bring my umbrella, so I got wet.　「持ってくるのを忘れた」は forget to ~。forget ~ing は「～したことを忘れる」。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: I forgot to bring my umbrella, so I got wet.

questions.question: [I] [am looking forward] [to hear] [from you].

tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: I am looking forward to hearing from you.

questions.question: Don't forget ___ (call) me tonight.

questions.explanation: Don't forget to call me tonight.　これからすることを忘れないように、なので forget to ~。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: Don't forget to call me tonight.

questions.question: I'm not used to ___ (speak) in public.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I'm not used to speaking in public.　be used to ~ing。
tags: 不定詞・動名詞の発展
questions.tts_text: I'm not used to speaking in public.

questions.tts_text: This book is too difficult for me to read.

questions.tts_text: She was kind enough to show me the way.

questions.tts_text: I had my hair cut yesterday.

questions.tts_text: Written in easy English, this book is good for beginners.

questions.question: ___ the window, I saw a bird.

questions.tts_text: Opening the window, I saw a bird.

questions.tts_text: I was very interested in the story.

questions.question: [The game] [was] [so] [bored] that I fell asleep.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい

questions.tts_text: The game was so boring that I fell asleep.

questions.question: [I] kept [him] [wait] [for an hour].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは I kept him waiting for an hour.　keep + 人 + ~ing で「人を～させたままにする」。
questions.tts_text: I kept him waiting for an hour.

questions.question: Everyone was ___ (shock) to hear the news.

questions.tts_text: Everyone was shocked to hear the news.

questions.tts_text: Seen from the sky, the island looks like a heart.

questions.question: 私はその知らせを聞いてわくわくしました。

questions.answer: I was excited to hear the news
questions.explanation: I was excited to hear the news.　人がわくわくするので excited。
questions.tts_text: I was excited to hear the news.

questions.question: 彼は目を閉じたまま座っていました。

questions.tts_text: He was sitting with his eyes closed.

questions.question: The story interested me.

questions.explanation: The story interested me. → I was interested in the story.　be interested in ~。
questions.tts_text: I was interested in the story.

questions.question: When she heard the news, she began to cry.

questions.rewrite_frame: ___ the news, she began to cry.

questions.tts_text: What he said was true.

questions.question: This is the house ___ I was born.

questions.tts_text: This is the house where I was born.

questions.question: I have a friend ___ father is a pilot.

questions.tts_text: I have a friend whose father is a pilot.

questions.question: Do you remember the day ___ we first met?

questions.explanation: Do you remember the day when we first met?　時の先行詞で、後ろが完全な文なので関係副詞 when。
questions.tts_text: Do you remember the day when we first met?

questions.tts_text: This is the town in which I lived ten years ago.

questions.question: Kyoto, ___ I visited last year, is famous for its temples.

questions.tts_text: Kyoto, which I visited last year, is famous for its temples.

questions.question: [This is] [the reason] [which] [he was late].

questions.question: ___ of the students has a computer.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Each of the students has a computer.　each of ~ は単数扱い。every は of をとらない。
questions.tts_text: Each of the students has a computer.

questions.question: A number of people ___ waiting outside.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: A number of people were waiting outside.　a number of ~（多くの～）は複数扱い。
questions.tts_text: A number of people were waiting outside.

questions.question: The number of students in Japan ___ decreasing.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The number of students in Japan is decreasing.　the number of ~（～の数）は単数扱い。
questions.tts_text: The number of students in Japan is decreasing.

questions.question: [He] [gave] [me] [many advices].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He gave me a lot of advice.　advice は数えられない名詞。
questions.tts_text: He gave me a lot of advice.

questions.question: [Every] [student] [have] [to] wear a uniform.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは Every student has to wear a uniform.　every + 単数名詞は単数扱い。
questions.tts_text: Every student has to wear a uniform.

questions.question: [I] [need] [a few] [information] about it.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは I need some information about it.　information は数えられない名詞なので a few は使えない（a little / some）。
questions.tts_text: I need some information about it.

questions.question: We need a few more ___ (chair).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: We need a few more chairs.　a few の後は複数形。
questions.tts_text: We need a few more chairs.

questions.question: How many ___ (sheep) are there on the farm?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: How many sheep are there on the farm?　sheep は単数と複数が同じ形。
questions.tts_text: How many sheep are there on the farm?

questions.question: 彼には友だちがほとんどいません。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.explanation: He has few friends.　数えられる名詞に「ほとんどない」は few。
questions.tts_text: He has few friends.

questions.question: 紙を2枚ください。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: please give me two sheets of paper
accept: give me two sheets of paper, please
questions.explanation: Please give me two sheets of paper.　paper は数えられない名詞。two sheets of paper。
questions.tts_text: Please give me two sheets of paper.

questions.question: We had a lot of rain last month.
questions.prompt_ja: ほぼ同じ意味になるように、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: We had a lot of rain last month. → It rained a lot last month.　天気の it + 動詞 rain。
questions.tts_text: It rained a lot last month.

questions.question: All the students have their own lockers.
questions.prompt_ja: Every で始めて、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: Every student ___ his or her own locker.
questions.explanation: All the students have their own lockers. → Every student has his or her own locker.　every + 単数名詞は単数扱い。
questions.tts_text: Every student has his or her own locker.

questions.question: I lost my umbrella, so I have to buy ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I lost my umbrella, so I have to buy one.　同じ種類の不特定のもの（a + 名詞）は one。特定のものは it。
questions.tts_text: I lost my umbrella, so I have to buy one.

questions.question: I have two brothers. One is a doctor, and ___ is a teacher.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I have two brothers. One is a doctor, and the other is a teacher.　2つのうち残りの1つは the other。
questions.tts_text: I have two brothers. One is a doctor, and the other is a teacher.

questions.question: This shirt is too small. Can you show me ___ one?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This shirt is too small. Can you show me another one?　「別のもう1つ」は another。
questions.tts_text: This shirt is too small. Can you show me another one?

questions.question: Please help ___ to the cake.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Please help yourself to the cake.　help yourself to ~ で「～を自由に取って食べる」。
questions.tts_text: Please help yourself to the cake.

questions.question: The climate of Japan is milder than ___ of Canada.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The climate of Japan is milder than that of Canada.　前に出た the + 単数名詞（the climate）のくり返しをさけるときは that。
questions.tts_text: The climate of Japan is milder than that of Canada.

questions.question: Some people like summer, and ___ like winter.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Some people like summer, and others like winter.　Some ~, others … で「～な人もいれば…な人もいる」。
questions.tts_text: Some people like summer, and others like winter.

questions.question: [I] [lost] [my pen] [and can't find one].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I lost my pen and can't find it.　なくした「その」ペンなので it。
questions.tts_text: I lost my pen and can't find it.

questions.question: [We] [enjoyed] [at the party] [very much].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは We enjoyed ourselves at the party very much.　enjoy は目的語が必要。enjoy oneself で「楽しむ」。
questions.tts_text: We enjoyed ourselves at the party very much.

questions.question: The ears of a rabbit [are] [much] [longer] than [a cat].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは The ears of a rabbit are much longer than those of a cat.　耳どうしを比べる。複数の the ears のくり返しは those（a cat's でもよい）。
questions.tts_text: The ears of a rabbit are much longer than those of a cat.

questions.question: Did you make this cake ___ (you)?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Did you make this cake yourself?　「自分で」は再帰代名詞。
questions.tts_text: Did you make this cake yourself?

questions.question: The boys introduced ___ (they) to the class.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: The boys introduced themselves to the class.　主語と目的語が同じ人なので再帰代名詞。
questions.tts_text: The boys introduced themselves to the class.

questions.question: 1つは赤で、もう1つは青です。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: one is red, and the other is blue
questions.explanation: One is red, and the other is blue.　2つのうち one と the other。
questions.tts_text: One is red, and the other is blue.

questions.question: どうぞご自由に食べ物をお取りください。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: please help yourself to the food
accept: help yourself to the food, please
questions.explanation: Please help yourself to the food.　help yourself to ~。
questions.tts_text: Please help yourself to the food.

questions.question: Some students walk to school. Other students come by bus.
questions.prompt_ja: 1文に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: Some students walk to school, and ___ come by bus.
questions.explanation: Some students walk to school. Other students come by bus. → Some students walk to school, and others come by bus.　other students ＝ others。
questions.tts_text: Some students walk to school, and others come by bus.

questions.question: He lived alone.
questions.prompt_ja: by を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: He lived alone. → He lived by himself.　by oneself で「一人で」。
questions.tts_text: He lived by himself.

questions.question: You will miss the bus ___ you hurry.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: You will miss the bus unless you hurry.　unless ~ で「～しない限り」（＝ if ~ not）。
questions.tts_text: You will miss the bus unless you hurry.

questions.question: Call me as ___ as you get home.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Call me as soon as you get home.　as soon as ~ で「～するとすぐに」。
questions.tts_text: Call me as soon as you get home.

questions.question: She can speak not only English ___ French.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: She can speak not only English but also French.　not only A but also B で「A だけでなく B も」。
questions.tts_text: She can speak not only English but also French.

questions.question: It was ___ hot that I couldn't sleep.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: It was so hot that I couldn't sleep.　so + 形容詞 + that ~ で「とても…なので～」。
questions.tts_text: It was so hot that I couldn't sleep.

questions.question: It was ___ a nice day that we went on a picnic.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: It was such a nice day that we went on a picnic.　名詞を含むときは such + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that ~。
questions.tts_text: It was such a nice day that we went on a picnic.

questions.question: I'm not sure ___ he will come or not.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I'm not sure whether he will come or not.　whether ~ or not で「～かどうか」。
questions.tts_text: I'm not sure whether he will come or not.

questions.question: [Both] [Tom] [or] [Ken] are from Canada.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは Both Tom and Ken are from Canada.　both A and B。
questions.tts_text: Both Tom and Ken are from Canada.

questions.question: [Although] [he was tired,] [but he kept] [working].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは Although he was tired, he kept working.　although と but はいっしょに使わない。
questions.tts_text: Although he was tired, he kept working.

questions.question: [I] [will] [go] [out unless it will rain].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
choices: ④ out unless it will rain
questions.answer: ④ out unless it will rain
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I will go out unless it rains.　条件を表す unless の中では、未来のことも現在形。
questions.tts_text: I will go out unless it rains.

questions.question: I'll call you as soon as I ___ (arrive).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.　時を表す as soon as の中は現在形。
questions.tts_text: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

questions.question: She studied hard so that she ___ (can) pass the exam.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: She studied hard so that she could pass the exam.　so that + 主語 + can で「～できるように」。過去の文なので could。
questions.tts_text: She studied hard so that she could pass the exam.

questions.question: 彼はとても疲れていたので、早く寝ました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: he was so tired that he went to bed early
questions.explanation: He was so tired that he went to bed early.　so ~ that …。
questions.tts_text: He was so tired that he went to bed early.

questions.question: 急がないと、学校に遅れますよ。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: you'll be late for school unless you hurry
accept: unless you hurry, you'll be late for school
questions.explanation: You'll be late for school unless you hurry.　unless ~ で「～しない限り」。
questions.tts_text: You'll be late for school unless you hurry.

questions.question: If you don't get up now, you'll be late.
questions.prompt_ja: unless を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: ___ get up now, you'll be late.
questions.explanation: If you don't get up now, you'll be late. → Unless you get up now, you'll be late.　if ~ not ＝ unless。
questions.tts_text: Unless you get up now, you'll be late.

questions.question: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.
questions.prompt_ja: so ~ that を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: This bag is so heavy that I ___ it.
questions.explanation: This bag is too heavy for me to carry. → This bag is so heavy that I can't carry it.　too ~ to … ＝ so ~ that … can't。that の後には it が必要。
questions.tts_text: This bag is so heavy that I can't carry it.

questions.question: Butter is made ___ milk.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Butter is made from milk.　材料の形が変わるときは be made from ~。
questions.tts_text: Butter is made from milk.

questions.question: This desk is made ___ wood.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This desk is made of wood.　材料の形が残るときは be made of ~。
questions.tts_text: This desk is made of wood.

questions.question: Kyoto is known ___ its old temples.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Kyoto is known for its old temples.　be known for ~ で「～で知られている」。
questions.tts_text: Kyoto is known for its old temples.

questions.question: This work must ___ by tomorrow.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This work must be finished by tomorrow.　助動詞 + be + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: This work must be finished by tomorrow.

questions.question: The baby was taken care ___ by her grandmother.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The baby was taken care of by her grandmother.　take care of の受動態は be taken care of by ~。of を落とさない。
questions.tts_text: The baby was taken care of by her grandmother.

questions.question: I was spoken ___ by a stranger on the street.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I was spoken to by a stranger on the street.　speak to ~ の受動態は be spoken to by ~。
questions.tts_text: I was spoken to by a stranger on the street.

questions.question: [The bridge] [will] [built] [next year].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは The bridge will be built next year.　助動詞の受動態は will be + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: The bridge will be built next year.

questions.question: [I] [was] [interested] [about] the story.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I was interested in the story.　be interested in ~。
questions.tts_text: I was interested in the story.

questions.question: [He] [was] [often] [laughed by] everyone.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He was often laughed at by everyone.　laugh at ~ の受動態は be laughed at by ~。
questions.tts_text: He was often laughed at by everyone.

questions.question: The room is ___ (fill) with people.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: The room is filled with people.　be filled with ~ で「～でいっぱいだ」。
questions.tts_text: The room is filled with people.

questions.question: She was made ___ (wait) for an hour.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: She was made to wait for an hour.　make + 人 + 原形 の受動態では to が必要（be made to ~）。
questions.tts_text: She was made to wait for an hour.

questions.question: この本はいつ書かれたのですか。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.explanation: When was this book written.　疑問詞 + be動詞 + 主語 + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: When was this book written.

questions.question: その犬は子どもたちにポチと呼ばれています。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: the dog is called Pochi by the children
questions.explanation: The dog is called Pochi by the children.　SVOC（call + O + C）の受動態。
questions.tts_text: The dog is called Pochi by the children.

questions.question: Everyone knows the singer.
questions.prompt_ja: 受動態に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Everyone knows the singer. → The singer is known to everyone.　「～に知られている」は be known to ~。
questions.tts_text: The singer is known to everyone.

questions.question: My uncle gave me this watch.
questions.prompt_ja: I を主語に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: I ___ this watch by my uncle.
questions.explanation: My uncle gave me this watch. → I was given this watch by my uncle.　SVOO の「人」を主語にした受動態。
questions.tts_text: I was given this watch by my uncle.

questions.question: Not ___ students like math.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Not all students like math.　not all ~ で「すべてが～というわけではない」（部分否定）。
questions.tts_text: Not all students like math.

questions.question: I have ___ been to Hawaii.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I have never been to Hawaii.　「一度も～ない」は never。ever は疑問文で使う。
questions.tts_text: I have never been to Hawaii.

questions.question: Tell me what ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Tell me what you want.　間接疑問は疑問詞 + 主語 + 動詞。
questions.tts_text: Tell me what you want.

questions.question: ___ did I dream of meeting him.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Little did I dream of meeting him.　否定の語 little を文頭に出すと、後ろは疑問文の語順になる（倒置）。
questions.tts_text: Little did I dream of meeting him.

questions.question: It was Ken ___ broke the window.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: It was Ken that broke the window.　It is ~ that … の強調構文。
questions.tts_text: It was Ken that broke the window.

questions.question: I don't like ___ of the two songs.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I don't like either of the two songs.　2つのうち「どちらも～ない」は not ~ either。
questions.tts_text: I don't like either of the two songs.

questions.question: [Not] every [students] [came] [to] the party.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは Not every student came to the party.　every の後は単数名詞。
questions.tts_text: Not every student came to the party.

questions.question: [I] [don't know] [why] [was she angry].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I don't know why she was angry.　間接疑問は疑問詞 + 主語 + 動詞。
questions.tts_text: I don't know why she was angry.

questions.question: [Never] [I have] [seen] [such a big fish].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは Never have I seen such a big fish.　否定の語 Never を文頭に出すと倒置が起こる。
questions.tts_text: Never have I seen such a big fish.

questions.question: Neither of the answers ___ (be) correct.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Neither of the answers is correct.　neither of ~ はふつう単数扱い（口語では are もあるが、入試では is）。
questions.tts_text: Neither of the answers is correct.

questions.question: None of the milk ___ (be) left.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: None of the milk is left.　none of + 数えられない名詞は単数扱い。
questions.tts_text: None of the milk is left.

questions.question: 金持ちが必ずしも幸せとは限らない。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: the rich are not always happy
questions.explanation: The rich are not always happy.　not always で「いつも～とは限らない」（部分否定）。
questions.tts_text: The rich are not always happy.

questions.question: 昨日その窓を割ったのはケンでした。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: it was Ken that broke the window yesterday
questions.explanation: It was Ken that broke the window yesterday.　It was ~ that … の強調構文。
questions.tts_text: It was Ken that broke the window yesterday.

questions.question: He didn't say anything.
questions.prompt_ja: ほぼ同じ意味になるように、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: He didn't say anything. → He said nothing.　not ~ anything ＝ nothing。
questions.tts_text: He said nothing.

questions.question: I have never seen such a tall tower.
questions.prompt_ja: Never で始めて、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: Never ___ seen such a tall tower.
questions.explanation: I have never seen such a tall tower. → Never have I seen such a tall tower.　否定の語を文頭に出すと、疑問文の語順になる。

questions.explanation: I have a lot of things. I must do them. → I have a lot of things to do.　名詞の後に to + 原形を置いて説明する。
questions.tts_text: I have a lot of things to do.

questions.question: Ken went to the shop and bought some milk.
questions.prompt_ja: 「買うために」という文に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: Ken went to the shop ___ some milk.
questions.explanation: Ken went to the shop and bought some milk. → Ken went to the shop to buy some milk.　目的は to + 原形。
questions.tts_text: Ken went to the shop to buy some milk.

questions.question: I enjoyed ___ with my friends.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I enjoyed talking with my friends.　enjoy の後は動名詞（~ing）。不定詞はとらない。
questions.tts_text: I enjoyed talking with my friends.

questions.question: Thank you for ___ me.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Thank you for helping me.　前置詞の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: Thank you for helping me.

questions.question: ___ English is fun.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Speaking English is fun.　主語になる「～すること」は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: Speaking English is fun.

questions.question: He finished ___ the book.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: He finished reading the book.　finish の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: He finished reading the book.

questions.question: How about ___ to the movies?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: How about going to the movies?　How about の about は前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。
questions.tts_text: How about going to the movies?

questions.question: I'm looking forward to ___ you.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I'm looking forward to seeing you.　look forward to の to は前置詞なので後ろは動名詞。
questions.tts_text: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

questions.question: [My brother] is good at [play] [the] [guitar].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは My brother is good at playing the guitar.　前置詞 at の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: My brother is good at playing the guitar.

questions.question: [We] enjoyed [to swim] [in] [the sea].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは We enjoyed swimming in the sea.　enjoy の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: We enjoyed swimming in the sea.

questions.question: [He] [left] [without] [say] goodbye.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He left without saying goodbye.　前置詞 without の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: He left without saying goodbye.

questions.question: She is interested in ___ (make) cakes.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: She is interested in making cakes.　前置詞 in の後は動名詞。
questions.tts_text: She is interested in making cakes.

questions.question: Please stop ___ (talk).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Please stop talking.　stop ~ing で「～するのをやめる」。
questions.tts_text: Please stop talking.

questions.question: 本を読むことは大切です。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.explanation: Reading books is important.　動名詞 reading books が主語。動名詞の主語は単数扱い。
questions.tts_text: Reading books is important.

questions.question: 私は早起きが得意ではありません。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: I'm not good at getting up early
questions.explanation: I'm not good at getting up early.　be good at ~ing で「～するのが得意だ」。
questions.tts_text: I'm not good at getting up early.

questions.question: I like to play soccer.
questions.prompt_ja: 動名詞を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: I like to play soccer. → I like playing soccer.　like は不定詞も動名詞もとる。
questions.tts_text: I like playing soccer.

questions.question: She started to sing.
questions.prompt_ja: 動名詞を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: She started to sing. → She started singing.　start は不定詞も動名詞もとる。
questions.tts_text: She started singing.

questions.question: You ___ happy today.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: You look happy today.　look + 形容詞で「～に見える」。
questions.tts_text: You look happy today.

questions.question: My uncle gave ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My uncle gave me a watch.　give + 人 + 物の語順。
questions.tts_text: My uncle gave me a watch.

questions.question: We call ___ "Taku."
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: We call him "Taku."　call + 人 + 名前で「人を～と呼ぶ」。人は目的格。
questions.tts_text: We call him "Taku."

questions.question: The news made me ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The news made me sad.　make + 人 + 形容詞で「人を～にする」。
questions.tts_text: The news made me sad.

questions.question: Mr. Ito teaches English ___ us.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Mr. Ito teaches English to us.　teach + 物 + to + 人。
questions.tts_text: Mr. Ito teaches English to us.

questions.question: My mother bought a new bag ___ me.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My mother bought a new bag for me.　buy + 物 + for + 人（「人のために」）。give・teach・show などは to。
questions.tts_text: My mother bought a new bag for me.

questions.question: [This soup] [tastes] [very] [well].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは This soup tastes very good.　taste の後は形容詞。well は副詞。
questions.tts_text: This soup tastes very good.

questions.question: [Please] [show] [me] [to your notebook].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは Please show me your notebook.　show + 人 + 物。to は要らない。
questions.tts_text: Please show me your notebook.

questions.question: [He] made [his mother] [very] [happily].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He made his mother very happy.　make + 人 + 形容詞。副詞は使えない。
questions.tts_text: He made his mother very happy.

questions.question: That sounds ___ (interest).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: That sounds interesting.　sound + 形容詞で「～に聞こえる・～のようだ」。
questions.tts_text: That sounds interesting.

questions.question: Will you tell ___ (we) the way to the station?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Will you tell us the way to the station?　tell + 人 + 物。人は目的格。
questions.tts_text: Will you tell us the way to the station?

questions.question: 彼女は私にその写真を見せてくれました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.explanation: She showed me the picture.　show + 人 + 物の語順。
questions.tts_text: She showed me the picture.

questions.question: 私たちはその犬をポチと名づけました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.explanation: We named the dog Pochi.　name + 物 + 名前で「～を…と名づける」。
questions.tts_text: We named the dog Pochi.

questions.question: Ken gave me this book.
questions.prompt_ja: to を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Ken gave me this book. → Ken gave this book to me.　give + 人 + 物 ＝ give + 物 + to + 人。
questions.tts_text: Ken gave this book to me.

questions.question: When I heard the news, I was happy.
questions.prompt_ja: make を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: When I heard the news, I was happy. → The news made me happy.　make + 人 + 形容詞で「人を～にする」。
questions.tts_text: The news made me happy.

questions.question: Tom is ___ than Ken.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Tom is taller than Ken.　than の前は比較級。
questions.tts_text: Tom is taller than Ken.

questions.question: This is the ___ question in the test.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This is the most difficult question in the test.　長い語の最上級は the most + 原級。
questions.tts_text: This is the most difficult question in the test.

questions.question: My bag is as ___ as yours.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My bag is as big as yours.　as ~ as の間は原級。
questions.tts_text: My bag is as big as yours.

questions.question: Which do you like ___, summer or winter?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Which do you like better, summer or winter?　2つのうち「どちらがより好き」は like ~ better。
questions.tts_text: Which do you like better, summer or winter?

questions.question: He is the fastest runner ___ our class.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: He is the fastest runner in our class.　最上級の後の範囲が場所・集団なら in、複数の人や物なら of。
questions.tts_text: He is the fastest runner in our class.

questions.question: This flower is ___ more beautiful than that one.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This flower is much more beautiful than that one.　比較級を強めて「ずっと」と言うときは much。very は使えない。
questions.tts_text: This flower is much more beautiful than that one.

questions.question: [This box] [is] [more heavier] [than that one].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは This box is heavier than that one.　heavy の比較級は heavier。more は重ねない。
questions.tts_text: This box is heavier than that one.

questions.question: [Mt. Fuji] [is] [the highest mountain] [of Japan].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.　範囲が場所のときは in。
questions.tts_text: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan.

questions.question: [She] [is] [not as] [taller as] her sister.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは She is not as tall as her sister.　as ~ as の間は原級。
questions.tts_text: She is not as tall as her sister.

questions.question: This is the ___ (good) movie of the three.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: This is the best movie of the three.　good の最上級は best。
questions.tts_text: This is the best movie of the three.

questions.question: Your English is ___ (good) than mine.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Your English is better than mine.　good の比較級は better。
questions.tts_text: Your English is better than mine.

questions.question: 私の兄は父と同じくらいの背の高さです。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: my brother is as tall as my father
questions.explanation: My brother is as tall as my father.　as + 原級 + as で「～と同じくらい」。
questions.tts_text: My brother is as tall as my father.

questions.question: あなたはどの季節がいちばん好きですか。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: which season do you like the best
questions.explanation: Which season do you like the best.　like ~ the best で「～がいちばん好き」。
questions.tts_text: Which season do you like the best.

questions.question: Ken is taller than Yuta.
questions.prompt_ja: Yuta を主語に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Ken is taller than Yuta. → Yuta is shorter than Ken.　主語を入れかえると反対の意味の比較級になる。
questions.tts_text: Yuta is shorter than Ken.

questions.question: This book is not as interesting as that one.
questions.prompt_ja: ほぼ同じ意味になるように、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: That book is ___ than this one.
questions.explanation: This book is not as interesting as that one. → That book is more interesting than this one.　not as ~ as（…ほど～でない）は比較級で言いかえられる。
questions.tts_text: That book is more interesting than this one.

questions.question: English is ___ in many countries.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: English is spoken in many countries.　受動態は be動詞 + 過去分詞。speak の過去分詞は spoken。
questions.tts_text: English is spoken in many countries.

questions.question: This house ___ built 100 years ago.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: This house was built 100 years ago.　100 years ago は過去。主語 This house は単数なので was。
questions.tts_text: This house was built 100 years ago.

questions.question: These pictures were taken ___ my father.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: These pictures were taken by my father.　「～によって」は by。
questions.tts_text: These pictures were taken by my father.

questions.question: ___ this room cleaned every day?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Is this room cleaned every day?　受動態の疑問文は be動詞を主語の前に出す。
questions.tts_text: Is this room cleaned every day?

questions.question: The window was ___ by Tom.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The window was broken by Tom.　break の過去分詞は broken。
questions.tts_text: The window was broken by Tom.

questions.question: The top of the mountain is covered ___ snow.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.　be covered with ~ で「～でおおわれている」。by 以外の前置詞を使う受動態。
questions.tts_text: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.

questions.question: [This song] [is] [loved] [from many people].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは This song is loved by many people.　受動態の動作をする人は by で表す。
questions.tts_text: This song is loved by many people.

questions.question: [The letter] [was] [wrote] [by Ken].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは The letter was written by Ken.　受動態は過去分詞。write の過去分詞は written。
questions.tts_text: The letter was written by Ken.

questions.question: [This book] [doesn't] [read] [by young people].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは This book isn't read by young people.　受動態の否定文は be動詞 + not + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: This book isn't read by young people.

questions.question: This bag was ___ (make) in Italy.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: This bag was made in Italy.　make の過去分詞は made。
questions.tts_text: This bag was made in Italy.

questions.question: Many stars can be ___ (see) here at night.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Many stars can be seen here at night.　助動詞 + be + 過去分詞。see の過去分詞は seen。
questions.tts_text: Many stars can be seen here at night.

questions.question: この寺は約800年前に建てられました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: this temple was built about 800 years ago
questions.explanation: This temple was built about 800 years ago.　受動態の過去は was / were + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: This temple was built about 800 years ago.

questions.question: その店では何が売られていますか。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: what is sold at the store
questions.explanation: What is sold at the store.　疑問詞 What が主語の受動態。
questions.tts_text: What is sold at the store.

questions.question: Many people visit this museum.
questions.prompt_ja: 受動態に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Many people visit this museum. → This museum is visited by many people.　目的語を主語にして be動詞 + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: This museum is visited by many people.

questions.question: Ken wrote this letter.
questions.prompt_ja: 受動態に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Ken wrote this letter. → This letter was written by Ken.　過去の文なので was + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: This letter was written by Ken.

questions.question: I have ___ in this town for ten years.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I have lived in this town for ten years.　現在完了は have + 過去分詞。for ~ で「～の間ずっと」（継続）。
questions.tts_text: I have lived in this town for ten years.

questions.question: Have you ever ___ to Okinawa?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Have you ever been to Okinawa?　「～へ行ったことがある」は have been to ~（経験）。
questions.tts_text: Have you ever been to Okinawa?

questions.question: She has been sick ___ last Monday.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: She has been sick since last Monday.　「～以来」と始まった時を表すのは since。期間の長さは for。
questions.tts_text: She has been sick since last Monday.

questions.question: How ___ have you known her? — For five years.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: How long have you known her? — For five years.　期間の長さをたずねるのは How long。
questions.tts_text: How long have you known her? — For five years.

questions.question: I ___ the movie last week.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I saw the movie last week.　last week のような過去のはっきりした時を表す語句は、現在完了といっしょに使わない。
questions.tts_text: I saw the movie last week.

questions.question: My uncle has ___ to Canada, so he is not in Japan now.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My uncle has gone to Canada, so he is not in Japan now.　have gone to ~ は「～へ行ってしまった（今ここにいない）」。
questions.tts_text: My uncle has gone to Canada, so he is not in Japan now.

questions.question: [I] [have] [never] [saw] a panda.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I have never seen a panda.　現在完了は have + 過去分詞。see の過去分詞は seen。
questions.tts_text: I have never seen a panda.

questions.question: [He] hasn't [cleaned] [his room] [already].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは He hasn't cleaned his room yet.　否定文の「まだ」は yet。already は肯定文で使う。
questions.tts_text: He hasn't cleaned his room yet.

questions.question: [We] [have known] [each other] [since ten years].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは We have known each other for ten years.　期間の長さには for を使う。
questions.tts_text: We have known each other for ten years.

questions.question: I have ___ (know) him since I was a child.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I have known him since I was a child.　know の過去分詞は known。
questions.tts_text: I have known him since I was a child.

questions.question: Have you ___ (eat) lunch yet?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Have you eaten lunch yet?　eat の過去分詞は eaten。
questions.tts_text: Have you eaten lunch yet?

questions.question: 私はちょうど駅に着いたところです。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: I have just arrived at the station
questions.explanation: I have just arrived at the station.　完了の現在完了。just は have と過去分詞の間。
questions.tts_text: I have just arrived at the station.

questions.question: あなたは何回北海道に行ったことがありますか。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: how many times have you been to Hokkaido
questions.explanation: How many times have you been to Hokkaido.　経験の回数は How many times。「行ったことがある」は have been to。
questions.tts_text: How many times have you been to Hokkaido.

questions.question: I came to Japan three years ago. I still live here.
questions.prompt_ja: 現在完了を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい

questions.question: I didn't know where she ___ (be).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I didn't know where she was.　前の動詞が過去（didn't know）なので、間接疑問の中も過去形にそろえる。
questions.tts_text: I didn't know where she was.

questions.question: 私は彼女が何を欲しいのか知りません。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: I don't know what she wants
questions.explanation: I don't know what she wants.　間接疑問は疑問詞 + 主語 + 動詞。
questions.tts_text: I don't know what she wants.

questions.question: 駅がどこにあるか教えてくれませんか。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: could you tell me where the station is
questions.explanation: Could you tell me where the station is.　tell + 人 + 間接疑問。
questions.tts_text: Could you tell me where the station is.

questions.question: Where does she live? I don't know.
questions.prompt_ja: 1文に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Where does she live? I don't know. → I don't know where she lives.　does を使わず、主語 + 動詞の語順にする。
questions.tts_text: I don't know where she lives.

questions.question: What is his name? Do you know?
questions.prompt_ja: 1文に、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: What is his name? Do you know? → Do you know what his name is?　疑問詞 + 主語 + 動詞の語順にする。
questions.tts_text: Do you know what his name is?

questions.question: My mother made me ___ my room.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My mother made me clean my room.　make + 人 + 原形で「人に（むりに）～させる」。
questions.tts_text: My mother made me clean my room.

questions.question: Let me ___ myself.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Let me introduce myself.　let + 人 + 原形で「人に～させてあげる」。
questions.tts_text: Let me introduce myself.

questions.question: Can you help me ___ this box?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Can you help me carry this box?　help + 人 + 原形で「人が～するのを手伝う」。
questions.tts_text: Can you help me carry this box?

questions.question: I saw a man ___ the street.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I saw a man cross the street.　see + 人 + 原形で「人が～するのを見る」。
questions.tts_text: I saw a man cross the street.

questions.question: My father didn't let me ___ out last night.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: My father didn't let me go out last night.　let + 人 + 原形。文が過去でも原形のまま。
questions.tts_text: My father didn't let me go out last night.

questions.question: I heard my name ___.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I heard my name called.　名前は「呼ばれる」ので過去分詞（hear + 物 + 過去分詞）。
questions.tts_text: I heard my name called.

questions.question: [The teacher] made [us] [to write] [a report].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは The teacher made us write a report.　make + 人 + 原形。to はつけない。
questions.tts_text: The teacher made us write a report.

questions.question: [Please] [let] [me] [knowing] the result.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは Please let me know the result.　let + 人 + 原形。
questions.tts_text: Please let me know the result.

questions.question: [I] [had] [my bike] [repair] yesterday.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは I had my bike repaired yesterday.　自転車は「修理される」ので have + 物 + 過去分詞。
questions.tts_text: I had my bike repaired yesterday.

questions.question: Mr. Green let us ___ (use) his computer.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Mr. Green let us use his computer.　let + 人 + 原形。
questions.tts_text: Mr. Green let us use his computer.

questions.question: I felt the house ___ (shake).
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I felt the house shake.　feel + 物 + 原形（または ~ing）で「～が…するのを感じる」。
questions.tts_text: I felt the house shake.

questions.question: 母は私に皿を洗わせました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: my mother made me wash the dishes
questions.explanation: My mother made me wash the dishes.　make + 人 + 原形。to は使わない。
questions.tts_text: My mother made me wash the dishes.

questions.question: 私は彼が部屋に入るのを見ました。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: I saw him enter the room
questions.explanation: I saw him enter the room.　see + 人 + 原形。
questions.tts_text: I saw him enter the room.

questions.question: My father allowed me to go to the concert.
questions.prompt_ja: let を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: My father ___ go to the concert.
questions.explanation: My father allowed me to go to the concert. → My father let me go to the concert.　allow + 人 + to ~ ≒ let + 人 + 原形。
questions.tts_text: My father let me go to the concert.

questions.question: Ken helped me with my homework.
questions.prompt_ja: 原形不定詞を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: Ken helped me with my homework. → Ken helped me do my homework.　help + 人 + 原形。
questions.tts_text: Ken helped me do my homework.

questions.question: If I ___ a bird, I could fly to you.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.　事実と違うことを仮定するときは過去形（be動詞はふつう were）。
questions.tts_text: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.

questions.question: I wish I ___ a car.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I wish I had a car.　I wish + 過去形で「～ならいいのに」。
questions.tts_text: I wish I had a car.

questions.question: If I had more time, I ___ travel abroad.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: If I had more time, I would travel abroad.　仮定法では would / could + 原形。
questions.tts_text: If I had more time, I would travel abroad.

questions.question: I wish I ___ speak French.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: I wish I could speak French.　I wish I could ~ で「～できればいいのに」。
questions.tts_text: I wish I could speak French.

questions.question: If I ___ you, I wouldn't say such a thing.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: If I were you, I wouldn't say such a thing.　「もし私があなたなら」は If I were you。
questions.tts_text: If I were you, I wouldn't say such a thing.

questions.question: If it ___ sunny today, we could go swimming. But it's raining.
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: If it were sunny today, we could go swimming. But it's raining.　今の事実（雨）と違うことを仮定しているので仮定法。
questions.tts_text: If it were sunny today, we could go swimming. But it's raining.

questions.question: [If] [I] [have] [a lot of money,] I would buy a house.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ③ は誤り。正しくは If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house.　仮定法では if の中も過去形。
questions.tts_text: If I had a lot of money, I would buy a house.

questions.question: I wish I [can] [play] [the piano] [well].
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ① は誤り。正しくは I wish I could play the piano well.　I wish の後は過去形。can → could。
questions.tts_text: I wish I could play the piano well.

questions.question: If I were you, [I] [will] [not] [go] there.
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ② は誤り。正しくは If I were you, I would not go there.　仮定法なので will ではなく would。
questions.tts_text: If I were you, I would not go there.

questions.question: If I ___ (be) rich, I would help poor people.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: If I were rich, I would help poor people.　仮定法の be動詞は were。
questions.tts_text: If I were rich, I would help poor people.

questions.question: I wish I ___ (live) near the sea.
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: I wish I lived near the sea.　I wish + 過去形。
questions.tts_text: I wish I lived near the sea.

questions.question: もし私に翼があれば、あなたのところへ飛んでいけるのに。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: if I had wings, I could fly to you
accept: I could fly to you if I had wings
questions.explanation: If I had wings, I could fly to you.　If + 主語 + 過去形, 主語 + could + 原形。
questions.tts_text: If I had wings, I could fly to you.

questions.question: 彼が私の兄だったらいいのに。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい（1つ不要な語句があります）
questions.answer: I wish he were my brother
questions.explanation: I wish he were my brother.　I wish + 主語 + were。
questions.tts_text: I wish he were my brother.

questions.question: I am sorry I can't swim.
questions.prompt_ja: ほぼ同じ意味になるように、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: I am sorry I can't swim. → I wish I could swim.　「泳げなくて残念」＝「泳げればいいのに」。
questions.tts_text: I wish I could swim.

questions.question: I don't have a bike, so I can't go there.
questions.prompt_ja: If を使って、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.rewrite_frame: If I ___ a bike, I could go there.
questions.explanation: I don't have a bike, so I can't go there. → If I had a bike, I could go there.　今の事実の反対を仮定するので過去形。
questions.tts_text: If I had a bike, I could go there.

questions.question: You are a student, ___?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: You are a student, aren't you?　肯定文の付加疑問は「否定の短縮形 + 主語の代名詞」。be動詞の文なので aren't you。
questions.tts_text: You are a student, aren't you?

questions.question: Ken plays tennis, ___?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Ken plays tennis, doesn't he?　一般動詞・3人称単数の文なので doesn't he。
questions.tts_text: Ken plays tennis, doesn't he?

questions.question: ___ a beautiful flower this is!
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: What a beautiful flower this is!　感嘆文：What + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + 主語 + 動詞!
questions.tts_text: What a beautiful flower this is!

questions.question: ___ fast he runs!
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: How fast he runs!　感嘆文：How + 形容詞・副詞 + 主語 + 動詞!
questions.tts_text: How fast he runs!

questions.question: "Don't you like cats?" "___. I love them."
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: "Don't you like cats?" "Yes, I do. I love them."　否定疑問文でも、答えが肯定（好き）なら Yes, I do。
questions.tts_text: "Don't you like cats?" "Yes, I do. I love them."

questions.question: Let's go shopping, ___?
questions.prompt_ja: ___ に入る最も適切なものを選びなさい
questions.explanation: Let's go shopping, shall we?　Let's ~ の付加疑問は shall we?
questions.tts_text: Let's go shopping, shall we?

questions.question: [She] can swim [very] [well,] [can she]?
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは She can swim very well, can't she?　肯定文の付加疑問は否定形。
questions.tts_text: She can swim very well, can't she?

questions.question: [What] [an] [interesting] [book is this]!
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ④ は誤り。正しくは What an interesting book this is!　感嘆文の最後は主語 + 動詞の語順。
questions.tts_text: What an interesting book this is!

questions.question: [How] [kind] [girl] [she is]!
questions.prompt_ja: 下線部のうち、誤りを含むものを1つ選びなさい
questions.explanation: ① は誤り。正しくは What a kind girl she is!　名詞（girl）を含むので What a + 形容詞 + 名詞。
questions.tts_text: What a kind girl she is!

questions.question: Your sister went to Osaka, ___ (do) she?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Your sister went to Osaka, didn't she?　一般動詞の過去の文の付加疑問は didn't。
questions.tts_text: Your sister went to Osaka, didn't she?

questions.question: Mike was absent yesterday, ___ (be) he?
questions.prompt_ja: ( ) の語を適切な形にして ___ に書きなさい（1語とは限りません）
questions.explanation: Mike was absent yesterday, wasn't he?　be動詞の過去の文なので wasn't he。
questions.tts_text: Mike was absent yesterday, wasn't he?

questions.question: なんて大きな犬なのでしょう。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: what a big dog it is
questions.explanation: What a big dog it is.　What + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + 主語 + 動詞!
questions.tts_text: What a big dog it is.

questions.question: あなたは昨日学校に来ませんでしたよね。
questions.prompt_ja: 日本文に合うように語句を並べかえなさい
questions.answer: you didn't come to school yesterday, did you
questions.explanation: You didn't come to school yesterday, did you.　否定文の付加疑問は肯定形 did you?
questions.tts_text: You didn't come to school yesterday, did you.

questions.question: This is a very beautiful picture.
questions.prompt_ja: What で始めて、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: This is a very beautiful picture. → What a beautiful picture this is!　What + a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + 主語 + 動詞!
questions.tts_text: What a beautiful picture this is!

questions.question: He is a very good singer.
questions.prompt_ja: How で始めて、___ に入る語句を書きなさい
questions.explanation: He is a very good singer. → How well he sings!　a good singer ≒ sing well。How + 副詞 + 主語 + 動詞!
questions.tts_text: How well he sings!
